findings.issue: string.IsNullOrEmpty(status) treats '?status=' as no filter. A strict reading of AC5 ('a status that is not one of the six names answers 400') could expect 400. The ticket does not mention empty values and the implementer documented the choice. [raised by opus, sol]
?status=paid selects 'Paid'. AC5 requires ignoring case only in the API; AC3 is silent on case for the page. This does not break any criterion.
